fields.Name: AIUsageDaily
fields.UserQuestion: What is our daily AI usage and cost broken down by model, agent, user, and scope?
fields.Description: Primary daily aggregation of AI usage facts. Computes run counts, token volumes, latencies (P50/P95), cache reads, and spend across all dimensional attributes.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Materialized analytical query over [__mj].vwAIUsageFacts. Parameterized by start and end window boundaries ({{ start | sqlString }} and {{ end | sqlString }}) on DayBucket, qualifying as RowFilterBroad. Broad source SQL strips the date window while preserving WHERE IsCompleted = 1 and grouping across the 10 dimensional columns with 15 measures. Materialized table refreshed daily.
